gh "issue" "create" "--repo" "cv/pit" "--title" "Add a `present` field to the typescript tool, for pi-action's workflow log" "--body" "pi-action (cv/pi-action#80) now lets a pi-durable tool say how the workflow log shows its calls, with an optional `present` field on the tool. pi-durable does not use the field, so other hosts ignore it. pi-action PR: see cv/pi-action#80 for the link.

Today pi-action has pit-specific code: it parses the `// @pit: {"label": "..."}` header to label `typescript` calls. Moving that into pit lets pi-action drop it, and lets pit show more than pi-action can guess.

## The contract

```ts
const tool = {
	...defineTool({ name: "typescript" /* ... */ }),
	present: {
		/** When the call starts: the 🔧 line, and the details in place of the arguments. */
		call(args): { title: string; body?: string },
		/** When it ends: the ↳ line in place of "N lines", and the details in place of the output. */
		result(args, result: ToolResultMessage): { summary?: string; body?: string },
	},
};
```

- Both functions are optional; each field left out gets pi-action's generic form.
- Plain text, synchronous, pure: pi-action calls them for stored entries, not while the tool runs. `result.details` is available, so `execute()` can put data there for `result()`.
- pi-action keeps its limits (120-character lines, 4000 characters of call body, the last 30 lines of result body) and blocks workflow commands. If a function throws or returns another type, pi-action falls back and warns once.

Full description: [Show tool calls in the workflow log](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/main/docs/extensions.md#show-tool-calls-in-the-workflow-log) (after the PR merges).

## What pit's `typescript` tool could return

- **`call`:** `title` = the label from the `// @pit:` header (or the `label` argument); `body` = the program without the header, then `params` as indented JSON, and `functionId` / `saveOnly` if set.
- **`result`:**
  - `summary`: the functions the program injected, such as `workspace.read · git.status`; on failure, the first line of the error.
  - `body`: the returned value as readable text: string fields such as `content` or `stdout` as they are, not as escaped JSON; other values as indented JSON.

## Example of the log

```text
🔧 Read activity.ts which renders tool call logs
▸   ↳ ✓ 0.1s · workspace.read
      async ({ workspace: { read } }) =>
        read("src/activity.ts", { format: "raw" })
      ──
      file: src/activity.ts
      content:
      // What pi does, in the workflow log as it happens…
```

Once a pit release has `present` and pi-action's workflows pin it, pi-action can remove its `// @pit:` parsing."
